title: ActionCatalog
description: Version 1: a game's own battle actions (decision 0018): enemy abilities now, skills from M5.5b. Attack, Guard and Item are built into the engine and resolved the same way. Damage comes from a registered formula; JSON never holds expressions.

targeting.description: enemy: one opponent; ally: one fighter on the user's side; self: the user; area: a shape centred on an opponent.

shape.description: Area actions only. radius falls off by steps (80%, 65%, 50%, 34%); lines hit at full strength.

reach.description: Which opponents it can be aimed at. Default: the user's own reach.

weight.description: Timeline weight: Attack is 100, Guard and Move 60, Item 80. Default 100.

formula.description: A registered formula. attack-defense: the user's attack minus the target's defence, plus the seeded -1/0/+1, at least 1.

percent.description: Scales the result before rounding. Default 100.

effects.description: What it does to each target. More effects (heal, status) join with their packets.
